March 25, 1935.    3    Morning Translation.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

NORTH CHINA GARAGE SUSPENDS BUSINESS.

The North China Garage on Nanzing Road
suspended business the other day because the company
is in debt to the amount of $80,000. Zee Ven Hao
(錢文豪), the manager of the garage, has disappeared.
The 34 motorcars of the garage have been taken over by
the creditors. The electricity, the telephone and the
water services to the garage have been discontinued.
The 72 chauffeurs of the garage have not yet
been paid their arrears of pay and nor has their cash
security been refunded. Yesterday the chauffeurs
held a meeting at which the following resolutions were
passed :-
1) That the garage find a guarantor for the refunding
of the $50 cash security to each chauffeur.
2) That the garage issue a notice stating whether
or not the owners will resume operations.
3) That the garage provide food and lodging to the
chauffeurs during the period of suspension of business.
4) That the owners issue the pay of workers for
the period of the suspension and that half pay be issued
to substitutes of workers.
The chauffeurs will open negotiations with
lawyer Zung Mou Shien(陳茂宣), who is liquidating
the company, to-day.

Sin Wen Pao (Peiping telegram) :-

DISPUTE BETWEEN MONGOLIA AND SUIYUEN.

The dispute between Suiyuen and Mongolia
over the collection of revenue is being mediated by
Hsiao Tsung Ying(蕭振瀛) and Pao Yoch Ching(包悅卿).
The Suiyuen authorities used to earmark the tax for their
military expenses, whilst the Mongolian Political Council
likewise depend upon this source of revenue to meet
expenses. It is claimed that the district affected is
located within Mongolian territory. Both sides are
taking a serious view of the dispute. The matter has
been brought to the notice of General Chiang Kai Shek
and Wang Ching Wei for instructions.
The report of an encounter between the troops
of Suiyuen and Mongolia on the night of March 21 is
unfounded.
On March 22 Pao Yoch Ching received a telegram
from Prince Teh(德王) of Mongolia, stating that the
Suiyuen authorities were collecting reinforcements and
that the situation at the front was becoming very grave.
On the morning of March 23, Pao Yoch Ching
called on General Ho Ying Ching and showed him the
telegram he had received from Mongolia. General Ho
informed him that measures were being devised to settle
the dispute and has instructed both parties to be calm.

1935年3月25日。 3 晨间译文。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：-

华北汽车行停业。

位于南京路的华北汽车行日前因公司负债达80,000美元而停业。该车行经理钱文豪（Zee Ven Hao）已失踪。车行的34辆汽车已被债权人接管。车行的电力、电话及供水服务均已切断。车行的72名司机尚未领到拖欠的工资，其现金保证金也未退还。昨日司机们举行会议，通过了以下决议：-
1) 要求车行为每位司机退还50美元现金保证金寻找担保人。
2) 要求车行发布公告，说明业主是否会恢复营业。
3) 要求在停业期间，车行为司机提供食宿。
4) 要求业主发放停业期间的工人工资，并向替班工人发放半薪。
司机们将于今日与负责清算该公司的律师陈茂宣（Zung Mou Shien）展开谈判。

《新闻报》（北平电报）：-

蒙古与绥远之争。

绥远与蒙古之间关于税收征收的争端正由萧振瀛（Hsiao Tsung Ying）和包悦卿（Pao Yoch Ching）进行调解。绥远当局过去将该税款指定用于军费开支，而蒙古政治委员会同样依赖这笔收入来支付费用。据称，受影响地区位于蒙古领土内。双方均严肃看待此争端。此事已提请蒋介石将军和汪精卫注意，以候指示。
关于3月21日晚绥远军队与蒙古军队发生冲突的报道纯属子虚乌有。
3月22日，包悦卿收到蒙古德王（Prince Teh）的电报，称绥远当局正在集结增援部队，前线局势变得非常严峻。
3月23日上午，包悦卿拜访了何应钦将军，并向他出示了收到的来自蒙古的电报。何将军告知他，正在制定措施解决争端，并指示双方保持冷静。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

Complaint by North China garage employees

At about 2.p.m. 22-3-35 Chen Seo Shuen, (陳懋宣 lawyer, acting for the head of the garage Chien Uen Heo, (錢文毫) came to the station and stated that he had interviewed two of the chauffeurs representatives but had refused to negotiate with them until the 16 motorcars belonging to the company had been restored.

This lawyer stated that it had come to his knowledge that 3 of the cars were being kept by an employee Ong Chin Zong, (王建中) this man was located at No.7. Nanzing Road when he stated that he is the man who is responsible for the rent of the garage at No.7 Nanzing Road, and as $755-24cts is owing for rent, and the Shanghai Commercial Bank, the landlords, are pressing him for payment, he arranged on the night of the 20th. March, '35 that 3 motorcars were taken from the garage at Rue de Zay Zoong, French Concession to the garage at No.7. Nanzing Road. On the morning of the 20th. March he removed the licence plates and had the cars placed in the godown of the Shanghai Commercial Bank at Nanzing Road as security for the rent owing, where they still remain.

It has been ascertained that the other 13 cars reported as stolen were taken away on the morning of the 20-3-35 by a male Chinese, Liu Tsai Ken. (虞財根) as the cars had been purchased on the Hire system and had not been fully paid for.

华北汽车行雇员投诉

1935年3月22日下午2时许，陈懋宣（Chen Seo Shuen，律师，代表车行负责人钱文毫（Chien Uen Heo））来到捕房，称他会见了两名司机代表，但在属于公司的16辆汽车归还之前，拒绝与他们谈判。

该律师称，他获悉其中3辆汽车由一名雇员王建中（Ong Chin Zong）扣留。此人在南京路7号被找到，他声称自己是负责南京路7号车行租金的人，由于欠租755.24美元，且房东上海商业储蓄银行催缴租金，他于1935年3月20日晚安排将3辆汽车从法租界亚尔培路（Rue de Zay Zoong）的车行移至南京路7号的车行。3月20日上午，他卸下车牌，并将车辆作为欠租的担保品存入上海商业储蓄银行在南京路的仓库，目前车辆仍存于该处。

经查实，其余 reported as stolen（报告被盗）的13辆汽车于1935年3月20日上午被一名中国男子虞财根（Liu Tsai Ken）开走，因为这些汽车是以分期付款购买方式购入，尚未付清全款。

March 23, 1935.

North China Garage - situation

The 30 chauffeurs of the North China Garage, 108
Nanzing Road, who have been staying since March 20 in the
house of Zien Wen-hao (錢文豪), Manager of the Garage,
at Lane 222, No.20 Avenue du Roi Albert, with the object
of pressing their demands for the immediate issue of
wages in arrears as well as the return of their guarantee
money, left the place on March 22, as Zien had not put in
an appearance. An attempt made by lawyer Chen Muir-sien
(陳懋宣), in his office at No.430 Chekiang Road, on the
afternoon of March 22, to mediate in the dispute proved
unsuccessful as neither the manager nor a representative
attended.

1935年3月23日。

华北汽车行 - 局势

华北汽车行（南京路108号）的30名司机自3月20日以来一直滞留在该车行经理钱文豪（Zien Wen-hao）位于阿尔贝王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）20号222弄的寓所内，目的是施压要求立即发放拖欠工资并退还保证金。由于钱文豪未露面，这些人于3月22日离开该处。3月22日下午，律师陈懋宣（Chen Muir-sien）在其浙江路430号的办公室试图调解此纠纷，但未成功，因为经理或其代表均未出席。

March 23, 1935. Morning Translation.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :-

CHAUFFEURS OF NORTH CHINA GARAGE ON GO-SLOW STRIKE

The North China Garage on Nanzing Road has 50 motorcars and employs over 70 chauffeurs. The garage has six sub-stations throughout the International Settlement and the French Concession.
Owing to poor business, the garage has not yet issued the wages of the chauffeurs for this month. Later the chauffeurs submitted a demand for the refund of the $50 cash security which they had deposited with the management but as the management was unable to refund the money, the chauffeurs went on a go-slow strike on March 21.
Subsequently the management promised to refund the security by instalments. Most of the chauffeurs have accepted the proposal. A committee has been organized by the management and chauffeurs to deal with the dispute. The dispute will be settled in the near future.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :-

WORKERS OF KWONG SANG HONG PERFUMERY FACTORY ON STRIKE

The Kwong Sang Hong (廣生行) Perfumery Factory at the corner of Tongshan and Paoting Roads employs 30 male workers and over 100 female workers. Recently these workers organized a labour union. Through some misunderstanding, two workers, who are members of the preparatory committee of the union, were dismissed on March 20. Yesterday morning while a worker named Lieu Sz Lien (劉汝廉) was about to leave the factory, he was arrested by the police.
At 7 a.m. yesterday the workers went on strike as a protest and detailed five representatives to make an appeal to the local Tangpu and the Bureau of Social Affairs. Officials have been detailed to make an investigation into the dispute and to fix a date for the holding of a mediation meeting.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :-

ONLY FIVE SILK FILATURES IN OPERATION IN SHANGHAI

When the silk trade was in a flourishing condition there were 113 silk filatures operating in Shanghai. Owing to the dumping of Japanese silk in Europe and America, the Chinese silk trade has declined with the consequence that many silk filatures have had to suspend operations.

1935年3月23日。晨间译文。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：-

华北汽车行司机怠工罢工

南京路的华北汽车行拥有50辆汽车，雇佣70多名司机。该车行在公共租界和法租界设有六个分站。
由于生意不佳，该车行尚未发放本月司机工资。随后，司机们要求退还向管理层缴纳的50美元现金保证金，但因管理层无力退款，司机们于3月21日开始怠工罢工。
此后，管理层承诺分期退还保证金。大多数司机已接受该提议。管理层和司机已组织一个委员会来处理此纠纷。该纠纷将在不久的将来得到解决。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：-

广生行香水厂工人罢工

位于同山路和保定路拐角处的广生行（Kwong Sang Hong）香水厂雇佣30名男工和100多名女工。最近，这些工人组织了一个工会。由于某种误会，两名身为工会筹备委员会委员的工人于3月20日被解雇。昨天上午，一名叫刘汝廉（Lieu Sz Lien）的工人在离开工厂时被警察逮捕。
昨天早上7点，工人们为表示抗议而罢工，并派出五名代表向当地塘沽局（Tangpu，音译，疑指当地行政机构或警局）和社会局申诉。官员已被派去调查此纠纷，并确定召开调解会议的日期。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：-

上海仅五家缫丝厂在运营

当丝绸贸易繁荣时，上海有113家缫丝厂在运营。由于日本丝绸在欧美倾销，中国丝绸贸易衰退，导致许多缫丝厂不得不暂停运营。

with the North China garage, with head offices at No.7

police, and it was found that the affair was the concern

station.

March 22, 1935.

North China Garage - Situation

Some 30 chauffeurs of the North China Garage, 108
Nanzing Road, which closed down on March 19 owing to financial
difficulties have been staying since March 20 in the house
of Zien Wen Hao (錢文豪 ), Manager of the garage, at Lane
222, No. 20 Avenue Du Roi Albert, with the object of pressing
their demands for the immediate issue of wages in arrears
as well as the return of their guarantee money. This garage
in addition to branches in the French Concession and the
head office at Nanzing Road, has a branch at No.1 Pingliang
Road.

华北汽车行——情况

位于南京路108号的华北汽车行因财务困难于3月19日停业，该行约30名司机自3月20日起一直滞留在该行经理钱文豪（Zien Wen Hao）的寓所内，地址为亚尔培路20号222弄，旨在施压要求立即发放拖欠工资并退还保证金。该汽车行除在法租界设有分行、总部设于南京路外，还在平凉路1号设有一处分号。

March 21, 1935.

Labour (4)

North China Garage - suspends business

Owing to financial difficulties, the North China
Garage, 109 Nanzing Road, has suspended business since
March 19. Consequently the 70 chauffeurs who are thus
affected are pressing the manager of the Garage for the
immediate issue of wages in arrears as well as the return
of their guarantee money.

（批：D 6599）

华北汽车行——停业

由于财务困难，位于南京路109号的华北汽车行自3月19日起停业。因此，受此影响的70名司机正向该车行经理施压，要求立即发放拖欠工资并退还保证金。
